name: Qianli Qinglu
note: High-chroma contemporary screen translation. The Public Domain reference artwork is preserved unaltered; these values are not claimed as scientific pigment measurements.

ink.role: primary text, axes and structural anchors

stoneGreen.role: primary-subject data marks and natural hierarchy

purple.role: fifth categorical root when identity requires it

policies.simple: Prefer one non-neutral root plus neutrals.
policies.binary: Use at most two non-neutral roots plus neutrals.
policies.categorical: Use no more than five roots; group long tails into Other.
policies.accessibility: Never encode a distinction by color alone; add labels, position, line style, marker or ordering. Use vivid roots for marks and their darker tonal partners for small text.
